name: lang-kotlin
description: Use when the user asks about Kotlin 2.x, coroutines, Flow and StateFlow, structured concurrency, null safety, data/sealed/value classes, the K2 compiler, KSP, Gradle Kotlin DSL, MockK or kotlinx.serialization.
